fixed: The first line of each title (YOUR VERY, DID IT REALLY) was dark ink on the dark dusk; titles over this world are light now, the stressed line in a gold box.
The opening title covered the memory bubble; the camera sits lower so the bubble is clear of it.

From the camera pulled all the way out, 6,641 people read as static; it stops closer, the people stand further apart in two calm colour families, and come up round you in waves as the camera pulls back.
The four in ten yellow bubbles did not stand out; the others dim as the yellow wave passes.
The crowd looked like rows of tombstones; each person has a lighter head a little apart from the body.

The toddler head had a stepped jaw, a floating box for a shirt and the brain window over the eye and ear; it is a round toddler head with a face, ear and curls, the window only on top, shoulders in your teal, and the shadow tone narrower on every big shape.
Among thousands the mascot was lost; a small YOU label stays over him in the crowd shots.

Rebuilt for one continuous camera (Biku, 2026-10-24: "most of the time it should be continuous camera shots"): no separate toddler head; the camera pushes in on you and your head turns into an x-ray with a small toddler brain, dives into the brain, then pulls straight back out of your head to the crowd.
